text:
Priya: starting thread for a surge-aware, tenant-sensitive rollout plan for the next model-capacity change. goal: avoid SLA impact during spikes and give predictable rollback windows.
Ben: +1. we need adaptive rules that step down percent when regional_queue_depth or GPU_util crosses thresholds. also include token_cost delta as a signal.
Jorge: propose tenant bucketing: high-value (no degrade unless critical), mid, low. rollout percentages should be weighted by bucket. e.g., high: 0% unless opt-in, mid: opt-in canary, low: automated ramp.
Elodie: for quality checks, do 5% control / 5% experiment A/B for 48 hours with mirrored evals on the same prompts. keep a high-value holdout of 1-2 enterprise tenants.
Sam: fallback policy sketch: if p95_latency > 2x baseline OR hallucination_rate > 0.02 OR token_cost_per_1k > 1.25x baseline -> trigger soft-fail: move to 80% stable / 20% candidate for 15m, notify on-call, then full rollback if no improvement.
Priya: good. flag naming convention we should use: toggle/geo/<region>/model-capacity/<model>-adaptive e.g. toggle/geo/eu/m3-adaptive
Ben: sample flag YAML for ops and infra to consume:
```
flag: toggle/geo/eu/m3-adaptive
phases:
  - pct: 2
    duration_mins: 30
    warmup_shadow_mins: 30
  - pct: 20
    duration_mins: 120
  - pct: 60
    duration_mins: 240
adaptive_rules:
  - metric: regional_queue_depth
    threshold: 1000
    action: reduce_pct_by: 50
  - metric: gpu_util
    threshold: 0.85
    action: reduce_pct_to: 10
fallback_variant: stable-m2
telemetry_gates: [p95_latency, hallucination_rate, token_cost_per_1k]
notify: [oncall, infra, product]
```
Jorge: also add 'tenant_allowlist' field so enterprises can opt-out or be excluded from experiment cohorts. and include 'max_qps_per_tenant' soft-limits so we don't blow up billing.
Elodie: on evaluation metrics: we'll compute embedding-sim similarity delta, n-gram novelty (for hallucination proxy), and human-sampled QA for top 100 failure prompts. pipeline should tag any cohort with >5% semantic drop.
Sam: operational rules: when adaptive rule fires, infra-bot should automatically modify flag percentages and create an incident draft with diagnostics (recent traces, top tenants affected).
infra-bot: scheduled reminder: run `./ops/validate-rollout --flag toggle/geo/eu/m3-adaptive --dry-run` before creating the flag.
Ben: note on cache warmup: add 'kv_prefill' step in deployment job. for stateful models we should copy K/V prefixes for hot prompts.
Priya: privacy/legal: Elodie, can you ping legal-bot for tenant notification flow? and confirm whether contract clause needed for model-capacity changes that might alter outputs.
legal-bot: noted. i'll draft a minimal customer communication template and an opt-out addendum for enterprise contracts. will post by EOD.
Jorge: one more: include a 'grace_period_mins' after a step change where we ignore minor blips to avoid oscillation. suggest 10m.
Elodie: agree. also require automatic bleedback window: if stable variant improves metrics after roll forward, candidate can be re-tested after 24h.
Priya: action items:
- Ben: implement flag YAML schema changes + validate CLI hook (infra tests)
- Jorge: tenant bucketing logic + opt-out list integration
- Elodie: evaluation plan, embed-based semantic checks, and dashboard panels
- Sam: incident auto-draft + infra-bot runbook hooks
- legal-bot: customer notification template + opt-out addendum
infra-bot: when you're ready run `./ops/validate-rollout --flag toggle/geo/eu/m3-adaptive --simulate` and post the dry-run output here.
Sam: i'll wire the auto-draft tonight and add basic diagnostics payload.
Ben: starting the schema PR, will include 'grace_period_mins' and 'tenant_allowlist' fields.
Priya: thanks team. let's review PRs and dry-run results on Thu 9am PT. please attach the simulate output and any failure samples ahead of the meeting. :calendar:
